exposure: VBAC vs no previous caesarean section
cohort: 100 women with a previous caesarean section and 100 women without a previous caesarean section.
finding: Trial of vaginal delivery in women with one prior lower segment caesarean section who present in spontaneous active labour may have a high success rate with no increased risk of maternal and fetal morbidity or mortality.
birth_weight: > 3500 g but < 4000 g in 2% of neonates in the VBAC group
